blind.description: An antique wooden cheval fire screen with a carved dark reddish-brown timber frame. It features two upright turned posts with pyramidal finials, supported on arched trestle feet. The crest has an ornate scrolled shell motif. The front panel features an inset tapestry or painted canvas depicting a colorful floral bouquet in a basket, framed by a patterned decorative border. The reverse side features a plain dark polished wood panel bordered with small brass stud details. Geometry is solid, clean, and fully manifold with no loose or floating elements.
blind.from_above: An I-beam or dumbbell-like shape consisting of a thin central horizontal bar connecting two perpendicular curved base feet at each end.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 40% to 45% the height of the figure (around 2 ft 4 in to 2 ft 6 in tall) and about 2 ft 6 in wide.
